name: Corn and Kelp Chowder
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 quart corn kernels (removed from the cob)
½ cup dried sea kelp (or laver)
1 green or red bell pepper, chopped

steps: Melt butter in a pan, add the kelp, and sauté until it begins to dissolve in the butter.
Add the remaining ingredients, turn down to low heat, and cover.
Remove cover and cook on low heat until water most of the liquid is evaporated.

culture.text: Chowder is a type of thick soup prepared with milk or cream, a roux, and seafood or vegetables. Oyster crackers or saltines may accompany chowders as a side item, and cracker pieces may be dropped atop the dish.
